turns.text: You are the registrar of Port Maren. For the records: the mail boat Zephyr is licensed to carry 12 passengers. Reply with a one-line acknowledgment.
Correction for your records: after refitting, the mail boat Zephyr is now licensed to carry 18 passengers, not 12. Acknowledge the correction in one line.
An inspector asks, and no papers are at hand: how many passengers is the mail boat Zephyr licensed to carry? Answer with just the number.
